notes: Version 1.0.225 — added optional network settings sync for labs with multiple computers.
changelog: New: optional network sync for lab settings. In Settings, point every computer in your lab at the same shared network folder and partner/lab data will sync automatically between them — including catching up automatically once a computer that was temporarily offline reconnects.

Changed: photo thumbnails ("Generuj miniaturki zdjęć" / "Miniaturki + raport HTML") are still saved at the lower default JPEG quality introduced in 1.0.223, resulting in meaningfully smaller files with no noticeable visual difference at thumbnail size.
